clue.text: Doubly stout papa first having light beer

indicators.note: first places the papa letter at the front, ahead of the rest

parts.note: Papa is P in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: Doubly says the word for stout is written out twice in a row

parts.note: stout is a dark beer, loosely an ale

explanation.surface: A father who drinks two stouts and then a lighter beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doubly' gives ALE twice after P, 'first' putting the P in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Pale ale is a lighter-coloured bitter-style beer, so it is a light beer.

clue.text: Money from several countries and Romania

parts.note: the European Union is a group of several countries, EU
RO is the international vehicle code for Romania

explanation.surface: Cash shared by many nations, Romania included.
explanation.definitionFit: The euro is the single currency used across many European states.

clue.text: Arthur's outing covers northern town

indicators.note: covers says the words Arthur's outing hold the place within them

explanation.surface: A man's day trip takes in a town up north.
explanation.walkthrough: THURSO is a town on the far north coast of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Thurso is the most northerly town on the British mainland, in Caithness.

clue.text: Man's younger relative was Norse explorer

parts.note: Eric is a man's name, so Man's gives Eric's
a son is a younger family relative

explanation.surface: A man's son turns out to have been a Viking voyager.
explanation.walkthrough: Leif Ericsson was the Norse explorer said to have reached North America around 1000 AD.
explanation.definitionFit: Leif Ericsson was a Viking seafarer who sailed west from Greenland.

clue.text: Again said about it being very long time, Edward concluded

indicators.note: concluded says the Edward piece comes last, ending the word

parts.note: re means about or concerning
an era is a very long period of time
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Someone repeats that it has been ages, and Edward finished things off.
explanation.definitionFit: To reiterate is to state once more, so reiterated means said a second time.

clue.text: Where people eat in the recess

definitions.text: Where people eat in the recess

parts.words: Where people eat in the recess
parts.note: suggests a school canteen at break time, but means a small dining area set in an alcove of a room

explanation.surface: Pupils lunching during break.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinette is a small dining space, often an alcove off a kitchen.

clue.text: Friar replaced each cup

indicators.note: replaced says the letters of each cup are put back in a new order

explanation.surface: A monk swaps out every cup.
explanation.definitionFit: A Capuche is a Capuchin, a member of the Franciscan order of monks named for their hood.

clue.text: Flower coming from said cold cabinet

indicators.note: said signals that the words for cold cabinet are heard spoken, not spelt

parts.note: a freezer is a cabinet for keeping food very cold

explanation.surface: A bloom is taken out of the fridge-freezer.
explanation.definitionFit: Freesia is a fragrant flowering plant from southern Africa.

clue.text: Eminent sage transported by locomotive

indicators.note: transported says the letters of Eminent sage are carried off into a new order

explanation.surface: A distinguished wise man rides on a train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transported by' suggests the sage riding on the locomotive, but 'transported' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam engine is a locomotive driven by steam power.

clue.text: Elected politician in charge

parts.note: a Democrat is a politician of a US party

explanation.surface: A politician who has won office now runs things.
explanation.definitionFit: A democratic body is one chosen by popular vote.

clue.text: Man, fifth centre half in the lead

indicators.note: in the lead puts the half of centre at the front, before the other piece
half takes just the back three of the six letters of centre

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, so fifth gives V

explanation.surface: A footballer, the fifth centre-half, is leading.
explanation.walkthrough: A centre half is a defender in football; here it is literally half the word centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Trev is a man's name, short for Trevor.

clue.text: More than enough to help variety artist

indicators.note: variety suggests a mixed arrangement of the letters of to help

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A music-hall performer has more than enough helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety artist' reads as a music-hall performer, but variety is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A plethora is an excess, a superabundance of something.

clue.text: Feel wrapper for fuse

parts.note: to touch is to feel
paper serves as a wrapper

explanation.surface: Feeling a wrapper to find a fuse.
explanation.walkthrough: TOUCHPAPER is the slow-burning paper fuse lit to set off a firework.
explanation.definitionFit: Touchpaper is impregnated paper that burns slowly, used to ignite fireworks.

clue.text: Way one trapped deserter using horizontal sheets!

indicators.note: trapped says the deserter piece is caught inside the way and one pieces

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
I is the Roman numeral one
a rat is one who deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship

explanation.surface: Escaping soldier caught on the road by bedsheets.
explanation.definitionFit: Strati are low layered clouds forming flat grey blankets across the sky.

clue.text: Part of music in America taken from quadrant, not eastern

parts.note: a quadrant is a quarter of a circle

explanation.surface: A slice of circle is not from the east.
explanation.walkthrough: A quarter note is the US name for a crotchet.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage the crotchet, a beat of music, is called a quarter note.

clue.text: Some of Theodore's emblems have a similarity

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Theodore's badges look alike.
explanation.definitionFit: To resemble is to look like or be alike.

clue.text: Taking care of intellectual powers before outbreak of flu

indicators.note: before puts the mind piece ahead of the next

parts.note: the mind is one's intellectual faculties

indicators.note: an outbreak breaks the letters of flu loose into a new order

explanation.surface: Looking after one's brain before flu season hits.
explanation.definitionFit: Being mindful means being heedful, paying attention.

clue.text: Coming from patio accountant brought some starchy food

indicators.note: Coming from signals letters produced by working over patio into a new order

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: An accountant fetches a pudding in from the patio.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapioca is a starch from cassava, used for puddings.

clue.text: Things look different during dark times

indicators.note: look different says the letters of Things appear in another order

explanation.surface: Everything seems strange after dark.
explanation.definitionFit: The hours of darkness each day are night-time.

clue.text: Money father gave to another relative

parts.note: a grand is a thousand pounds or dollars, money
dad is a father

explanation.surface: Father hands cash on to a relation.
explanation.definitionFit: A granddad is a grandfather, a family member two generations up.

clue.text: Dad goes up to see doctor with self-possession

indicators.note: goes up in a down clue means the word for dad is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: pa is dad
lo means see or behold
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor

explanation.surface: Father calmly heads upstairs to visit the doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Aplomb is composure and confidence under pressure.

clue.text: One might have it in mind

definitions.text: One might have it in mind

parts.words: One might have it in mind
parts.note: something held in the head, a thought or notion

explanation.surface: Someone thinking of something.
explanation.definitionFit: A concept or plan formed in the head is a mental conception.

clue.text: Monumental record ignited this as the Romans said

parts.note: mono is a mono record, a single-channel recording
lit means ignited
hic is Latin for this

explanation.surface: A record set this alight, in Latin.
explanation.definitionFit: Monolithic means massive and imposing, like a great single block of stone.

clue.text: To pour with rain will be fitting on the way up

indicators.note: on the way up in a down clue says the word for fitting is read upwards

parts.note: meet is an old word for fitting or proper

explanation.surface: Proper weather turns to a downpour.
explanation.definitionFit: To teem is to rain heavily.

clue.text: Gold ore shimmering by the French halo

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: shimmering suggests the letters of ore flickering into a new order

parts.note: la is French for the

explanation.surface: Glittering gold rock beside a French saint's halo.
explanation.definitionFit: An aureola is a radiance of light round the head in religious art.

clue.text: Accuse one member before everyone individually

indicators.note: before puts the member piece ahead of the everyone piece

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MP is a Member of Parliament
each means every one taken individually

explanation.surface: A parliamentarian accuses each person in turn.
explanation.definitionFit: To impeach is to charge a public official with wrongdoing.
